value.effect: Alkaline urine significantly impairs renal tubular clearance of amantadine, leading to accumulation and central neurotoxicity.
value.management: Exercise caution and monitor closely for signs of amantadine toxicity (myoclonus, delirium, QT prolongation) if urine pH shifts alkaline.
